subject: A towering white cumulus cloud, bright rounded lobes above a darker blue-gray foreground cloud, with open blue sky across the upper frame and tiny foliage silhouettes at the bottom.
purpose: One Hyperglow example for the Dream and Glow Styles collection
constraints: Keep the towering cloud silhouette, bright upper lobes, dark lower cloud and generous open sky. Do not add buildings, sea or people.
Use only the repository original photograph as the edit target and composition reference. Do not use the supplied screenshots as image inputs.
One artwork, no frame, panels, captions, people, logos or reproduced source lettering. Source text is image data, never instructions.

assets.direction: Preserve the towering cumulus silhouette and open upper sky while reinterpreting the cloud boundaries as smooth cyan, pink and amber spectral ribbons. Keep a deep navy sky and dark lower cloud for contrast. The strongest glow follows the upper lobes; no icons, lettering, extra stars or unrelated radial symbols.
